title: 六级主题练习 01 · 公共选择与长期视角
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考六级试卷中的公共议题、数字生活和政策阅读结构，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: A convenient service is valuable only when people can understand its limits. A map application can find a quick route, but it may not know that a path is closed or unsafe at night. Users should treat digital suggestions as useful information rather than final decisions. Service providers should explain what their systems can and cannot do. Clear notices, updated data and an easy way to report errors can prevent small mistakes from becoming serious problems. Schools can ask students to compare an online recommendation with evidence from the real world. Convenience should save time, not remove judgment. When people understand a tool’s limits, they can use its strengths with greater confidence and remain responsible for their choices.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: A city introduced a rent-support programme after a careful [1] ______ of housing costs. Officials did not simply announce a single [2] ______. They compared different neighbourhoods and [3] ______ tenants, landlords and local groups. The first report showed that a short-term payment could help some families but would not [4] ______ the wider shortage. The city therefore combined emergency support with a longer plan to [5] ______ affordable homes.
study_paragraphs: A city introduced a rent-support programme after a careful assessment of housing costs. Officials did not simply announce a single measure. They compared different neighbourhoods and consulted tenants, landlords and local groups. The first report showed that a short-term payment could help some families but would not resolve the wider shortage. The city therefore combined emergency support with a longer plan to increase affordable homes.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 assessment，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 measure，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 consulted，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 resolve，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 increase，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 信息匹配 · 公共选择与长期视角
sections.instructions: 根据段落内容完成匹配。
paragraphs: [A] Remote workers move between cities in search of reliable internet. A small town attracted them by improving its public network and opening quiet work rooms. The project also asked visitors to respect local housing.
[B] A housing survey compared advertised rents with the total cost of living. Transport, heating and travel time changed the apparent advantage of a cheap flat.
[C] A public office replaced a complicated form with a short online version. It kept a paper form and a staffed phone line for people without reliable internet.
[D] A council published its budget in plain language. Residents could see what had been spent and why projects had changed. Attendance at meetings increased.

questions.prompt: A digital reform remains inclusive when alternatives are preserved.
questions.explanation: C段保留纸质表格和电话服务。

questions.prompt: Digital workers need infrastructure as well as social responsibility.
questions.explanation: A段同时强调网络设施和对当地的责任。

questions.prompt: Clear information can improve public participation.
questions.explanation: D段预算透明后居民参与增加。

questions.prompt: The real cost of housing includes more than rent.
questions.explanation: B段把交通、取暖和通勤时间纳入比较。

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The cost of a short route
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A delivery company celebrated software that reduced drivers’ average distance. It sent vehicles through a narrow street beside a school, and parents complained about noise. The company measured travel time, fuel use and local disruption together. A slightly longer route avoided the busiest period and produced a more stable arrangement.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · A policy that learned
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A university required every department to reduce printing. One department removed several printers, then discovered that students with visual difficulties depended on a nearby machine. It tested a shared printer with accessible settings and kept most routine work online. The final policy used less paper without assuming the same solution suited every user.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 中国许多城市正在改善公共交通，以便让居民更方便地往返工作和生活。除了建设地铁和公交线路，一些城市还增加了自行车道，并通过手机应用提供实时信息。良好的交通系统不仅可以缩短出行时间，还能减少道路拥堵和空气污染。
study_paragraphs: Many Chinese cities are improving public transport to make it easier for residents to travel between work and home. In addition to building subway and bus routes, some cities are adding bicycle lanes and providing real-time information through mobile applications. A good transport system can shorten travel time and reduce traffic congestion and air pollution.
